diffs.diff: chip ID register 0x20: part 16656, datasheet reading 65
diffs.evidence: MCP960X datasheet DS20005426G p.41, Register 5-13 'MCP9601/L01/RL01 DEVICE ID AND REVISION ID REGISTER' is 16 bits: 'bit 15-8 Device ID: Device ID bits (0x41)'; 'bit 7-0 Revision: Major/Minor Revision ID bits (0x10) for the initial Release'. POR bit pattern 0100 0001 0001 0000 = 0x4110 = 16656. The model's sim uses regWidth 16, so the full register value is 16656; the second reading's 65 (0x41) is only the upper Device ID byte, which is exactly what the driver checks (first byte of a 2-byte read == 0x41). Both agree; units/width differ.
